explication: Pi.Alert detects devices and connectivity changes on a Wi-Fi/LAN, records them, and presents inventory, event, session, and presence information through a web interface. The documented monitoring workflow uses arp-scan, with optional Pi-hole and dnsmasq discovery, then stores findings and reports changes by email. The frontend provides device inventory and editing, events, and presence views backed by PHP endpoints and SQLite. Backend implementation details beyond the README are not expanded here; the sampled excerpts establish several frontend request paths, but not every page-to-endpoint connection.
